en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānuloma (1), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 1.7.
Vitakkattika (The Triplet on Applied Thought)
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.
1.7.1. The Section on Dependent Arising 1.7.1.1.
Positive Conditionality (Paccayānuloma)
Section on Analysis:
Root Condition.

Dependent upon a state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, a state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition—[namely,] a state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought...
Dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates [arise]; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate [arises];

dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought, three aggregates [arise] …pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].

Dependent on a state with applied thought and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*), a state without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*) arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*):

dependent on the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, applied thought (*vitakka*) arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking (*paṭisandhi*), dependent on the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, applied thought arises.

Dependent on a state with applied thought and sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought (*avitakka-avicāra*) arises by way of root condition: [dependent on] the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought...

Dependent on aggregates, mind-originated matter arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application, kamma-produced matter arises.

Dependent on a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application, there arise states both accompanied by initial application and sustained application, and those without initial application and sustained application.

They arise by way of the root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter.

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and kamma-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates … [and so forth].
Dependent on [one] aggregate, there arise two aggregates and derived matter.

Dependent on a state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, there arise states that are without applied thought but with sustained thought, and states that are without applied thought and without sustained thought, by way of root condition:
dependent on aggregates accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, there arises applied thought and mind-originated matter.

Material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application, there arise initial application and the material form produced by kamma (*kaṭattā-rūpa*).

Dependent on a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application, states accompanied by initial application and sustained application, as well as states without initial application but with sustained application alone, arise by way of root condition:
dependent on one aggregate accompanied by initial application and sustained application, there arise three aggregates and initial application.

And ... [as before] ... dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and applied thought (*vitakka*). At the moment of rebirth-linking (*paṭisandhi*), dependent on one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*), there arise three aggregates and applied thought ...
[as before] ... dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and applied thought.

Dependent on a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought, there arise states accompanied by applied and sustained thought, those with sustained thought only (*avitakkavicāramatta*), and those without applied or sustained thought (*avitakka-avicāra*).

And states arise by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought, there arise three aggregates, applied thought, and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates, applied thought, and mind-produced matter.

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought …pe… [dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates, applied thought, and kamma-produced matter].

Three aggregates, applied thought (*vitakka*), and the matter produced by karma (*kaṭattā-rūpa*) ... [and so on] ... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates, applied thought, and the matter produced by karma arise.

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*), a state without applied thought but with sustained thought arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*): [dependent on] a state without applied thought but with sustained thought...
Dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.
Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought, a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition: [dependent on] applied thought …

Dependent on [a state] with applied thought and sustained thought, there arise aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, there arise aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought.
Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of root condition:
dependent on aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise sustained thought and mind-produced matter; dependent on applied thought, there arises mind-produced matter.
Material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, depending on aggregates that are without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arises sustained thought and kamma-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, depending on applied thought, there arises kamma-produced matter.

Depending on a state that is without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise states that are both with applied thought and with sustained thought, and states that are without applied thought and without sustained thought.

They arise by way of the root condition: dependent on applied thought (*vitakka*), there arise aggregates accompanied by both applied and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*) and mind-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, there arise aggregates accompanied by both applied and sustained thought and kamma-produced matter.

Dependent on a state that is without applied thought but with sustained thought alone (*avitakkavicāramatta*), there arise states that are either without applied thought but with sustained thought alone, or without both applied and sustained thought (*avitakka-avicāra*).

They arise by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*): dependent on one aggregate that is without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*), there arise three aggregates, sustained thought, and mind-produced matter;
... dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates, sustained thought, and mind-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking (*paṭisandhi*), dependent on one aggregate that is without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and sustained thought.
...and matter produced by past action (*kaṭattā-rūpa*) ...pe... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates, sustained thought (*vicāra*), and matter produced by past action arise.

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought (*avitakka-avicāra*), a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*):

dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise ...pe... dependent on two aggregates, [three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise].
Two aggregates and mind-produced matter; mind-produced matter dependent on sustained thought (*vicāra*).

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought or sustained thought (*avitakka-avicāra*), there arise three aggregates and kamma-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and kamma-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-produced matter arises dependent on sustained thought.

Dependent on the aggregates, there is the physical basis; dependent on the physical basis, there are the aggregates. Dependent on sustained thought, there is the physical basis; dependent on the physical basis, there is sustained thought.

Dependent on one great primary element, there are three great primary elements ... [and so on] ... dependent on the great primary elements, there is mind-produced matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter.

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought arise.
Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition:

dependent on sustained thought, the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on sustained thought, the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought arise.

The aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis (vatthu), there arise aggregates accompanied by vicāra but devoid of vitakka. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, there arises vitakka.
Dependent on a state that is devoid of both vitakka and vicāra, there arise states that are accompanied by both vitakka and vicāra, as well as states that are devoid of vitakka and vicāra.
Conditioned by root-cause: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis (vatthu), there are aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought;
dependent on the great elements, there is kamma-produced matter.
Dependent on a state without applied thought and sustained thought, there arise states both with sustained thought only and without applied thought and sustained thought.

They arise by way of root condition: dependent on sustained thought (*vicāra*), there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*) and mind-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on sustained thought, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought and kamma-produced matter.

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the [heart-]base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought; and dependent on the great elements, there arises kamma-produced matter.

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis (vatthu), there is applied thought (vitakka); dependent on the great primary elements (mahābhūta), there is kamma-produced matter (kaṭattārūpa).

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, there are aggregates accompanied by sustained thought but without applied thought (avitakkavicāramatta) and sustained thought (vicāra).

Dependent on a state without applied thought or sustained thought (avitakka-avicāra), states with both applied and sustained thought (savitakkasavicāra) and states with sustained thought but without applied thought arise by way of root condition (hetupaccaya): at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, there are aggregates with both applied and sustained thought and applied thought.

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise states with applied thought and sustained thought, without applied thought but with sustained thought, and without applied thought and without sustained thought, by way of root condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical basis, there arise aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, as well as applied thought;
and dependent on the great primary elements, there arises kamma-produced matter.
Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought, a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition:
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought and the [heart-]base,
three aggregates arise …pe… dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*) and without applied thought and sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*), a state without applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*): at the moment of rebirth-linking (*paṭisandhi*), dependent on the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought and the physical basis (*vatthu*), applied thought (*vitakka*) arises.

Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought, a state without applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition:
dependent on the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought and the great elements (*mahābhūta*), mind-originated matter (*cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa*) arises.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought and the great primary elements, there arises kamma-produced matter.

Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought, states with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought arise by way of root condition—
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought...
Dependent on a [mental] basis, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates and a basis, two aggregates arise;
dependent on aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought and the great primary elements, kamma-produced matter arises.

Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought, there arise states without applied thought but with sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought.

And states arise by way of root-condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought and the [heart-]base, there arises applied thought;
dependent on the aggregates accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought and the great primary elements, there arises kamma-produced matter.

Dependent on states both accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought and sustained thought, there arise states accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, and [states] without applied thought but with sustained thought alone.

And states arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*) and the [heart-]base, there arise three aggregates and applied thought;
... pe ... dependent on two aggregates and the base, there arise two aggregates and applied thought.

Dependent on a state that is both with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*), there arise states that are both with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought but with sustained thought.
And states that are without applied thought and sustained thought arise by way of root condition:

at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought and the [heart-]base, there arise three aggregates and applied thought …pe… dependent on two aggregates and the [heart-]base, there arise two aggregates and applied thought;
and dependent on aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought and the great primaries, there arises kamma-produced matter.

Dependent on a state that is without applied thought but with sustained thought, and a state that is without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arises a state with applied thought and sustained thought by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the physical basis, the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought arise.

Dependent on a state that is without applied thought but with sustained thought, and a state that is without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arises a state without applied thought but with sustained thought by way of root condition:
dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought and sustained thought, three [aggregates] arise.

The aggregates … [as before] … dependent on two aggregates and sustained thought (vicāra), there are two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought and sustained thought, there are three aggregates … [as before] … dependent on two aggregates and sustained thought, there are two aggregates.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought and the physical basis (vatthu) … [as before].
Three aggregates … [and so on] … two aggregates and the physical basis (vatthu) in dependence upon two aggregates.

Dependent on states that are without applied thought but with sustained thought and without both applied and sustained thought, a state without both applied and sustained thought arises by way of root condition:
dependent on aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought and sustained thought itself, mind-produced [matter arises].
Materiality: materiality produced by consciousness dependent on aggregates that are without applied thought but with sustained thought, and the great primaries;

materiality produced by consciousness dependent on both applied thought and the great primaries. At the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-produced materiality arises dependent on aggregates that are without applied thought but with sustained thought, and on sustained thought.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, [dependent on] aggregates that are without applied thought but with sustained thought...
And dependent on great primaries, there is kamma-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the great primaries, there is kamma-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates that have no applied thought but have sustained thought and the physical basis, there is sustained thought.

Dependent on states that have neither applied nor sustained thought, and on states that have no applied thought but have sustained thought, there are states with both applied and sustained thought, as well as states that have neither applied nor sustained thought.

And states arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought (*vitakka*) and the physical basis (*vatthu*), there are aggregates accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*);
and dependent on applied thought and the great elements (*mahābhūta*), there is kamma-produced form (*kaṭattārūpa*).

Also, dependent on a state that is without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*) and a state that is without both applied and sustained thought (*avitakka-avicāra*), there arises a state that is without applied thought but with sustained thought...

States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, and on sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, [dependent on] one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and kamma-produced matter. Dependent on sustained thought, there arises mind-produced matter. Dependent on the four aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arises kamma-produced matter. Dependent on one great primary, there arise three great primaries …pe… dependent on great primaries, there arises mind-produced and kamma-produced derived matter. (2) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (3) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (4) States without applied thought but with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought. (5) States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought. (6) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (7) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (8) States without applied thought but with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought. (9) States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought. (10) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (11) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (12) States without applied thought but with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought. (13) States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought. (14) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (15) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (16) States without applied thought but with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought. (17) States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought. (18) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (19) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (20) States without applied thought but with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought. (21) States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought. (22) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (23) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (24) States without applied thought but with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates and on sustained thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought. (25) States without applied thought and without sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought. (26) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a root condition: dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and with sustained thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter …pe… dependent on two aggregates, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. Dependent on the heart-base, there arise aggregates with applied thought and with sustained thought. (27) States with applied thought and with sustained thought arise with a
Dependent on one aggregate and sustained thought (vicāra), there arise three aggregates and kamma-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates and sustained thought,
there arise two aggregates and kamma-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought and the heart-base,
there arise three aggregates and sustained thought … dependent on two aggregates and the heart-base … [and so forth].
Dependent on [one] aggregate, [another] aggregate, and sustained thought (vicāra).

Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought (savitakkasavicāra) and without applied thought but with sustained thought (avitakkavicāramatta), a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition (hetupaccaya):
dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought and applied thought (vitakka), three [other aggregates arise].

The aggregates … [etc. … dependent on two aggregates and applied thought (vitakka), there arise two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought (savitakkasavicāra) and applied thought, there arise three aggregates … [etc.
… dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, there arise two aggregates.
Dependent on states with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arises a state without applied thought and sustained thought.
[Material form] arises by way of root-condition: dependent on aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, and applied thought, there arises mind-originated matter;
at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, and applied thought, there arises kamma-produced matter.
Dependent on states both with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought but with sustained thought, [there arise states] with applied thought and sustained thought...
And states without applied thought and sustained thought arise by way of root condition:
dependent on one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought, and applied thought, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter;

… dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, there arise two aggregates and mind-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, [dependent on] one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought … [and so forth].

Dependent on one aggregate and applied thought (vitakka), there arise three aggregates and kamma-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, there arise two aggregates and kamma-produced matter.

Dependent on a state that possesses both applied thought and sustained thought (savitakkasavicāra), as well as states without applied thought but with sustained thought only (avitakkavicāramatta) and states without either applied or sustained thought (avitakka-avicāra), there arises a state possessing both applied thought and sustained thought.
A state arises by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought,
applied thought, and the heart-base, three aggregates [arise] …pe… dependent on two aggregates, applied thought, and the heart-base, two aggregates [arise].

Dependent on states that are with applied thought and sustained thought, without applied thought but with sustained thought, and without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of root condition:
dependent on the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great elements, mind-produced matter [arises].
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought and applied thought...
And dependent on the great primary elements, kamma-produced matter arises.
Dependent on states that are with applied thought and sustained thought, without applied thought but with sustained thought, and without applied thought or sustained thought,

there arise states that are with applied thought and sustained thought and without applied thought or sustained thought by way of root condition— at the moment of rebirth-linking, [dependent on] the state with applied thought and sustained thought...
Dependent on one aggregate, applied thought, and the heart-base, there arise three aggregates; dependent on three aggregates, applied thought, and the heart-base, there arises one aggregate;
dependent on two aggregates, applied thought, and the heart-base, there arise two aggregates;
and dependent on aggregates accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great primary elements, there arises kamma-produced matter.

Conditioned by a state with applied thought and sustained thought as object, a state with applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of object condition: conditioned by one aggregate with applied thought and sustained thought, three aggregates [arise] … conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking … [etc. … Conditioned by a state with applied thought and sustained thought as object, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought arises by way of object condition: conditioned by aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, mind-consciousness-element arises; conditioned by aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, mind-consciousness-element accompanied by joy arises; conditioned by aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, mind-consciousness-element accompanied by equanimity arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking … [etc. … Conditioned by a state with applied thought and sustained thought as object, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of object condition: conditioned by aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, mind-element arises; conditioned by aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, mind-consciousness-element arises; conditioned by aggregates with applied thought and sustained thought, body-consciousness-element arises.
